support-ale: FYI ticket #12345 — customer reports higher latency, traces show requests landing in eu-west even though their app submits region=us-west in form data. Can we triage?
ops-bot: automated-alert: edge-router: routing header X-Region present but empty (len=0) -> header-priority path taken
support-ale: minimal repro from customer:
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...\" \n  -H \"X-Region:\" \n  -F \"region=us-west-2\" \n  -F \"prompt=hello\"
```
ingrid-eng: Ah — looks like our router treats the mere presence of the X-Region header as higher precedence than form/query params, even if the header value is empty or whitespace. That will cause fallback to default/nearest POP (customer sees eu-west).
infra-max: I pulled the edge trace for one of the request IDs in the ticket: 
```
[edge] 2026-07-14T11:22:33Z decision: header_key=X-Region value=\"\" (len=0) -> header used -> region_unresolvable -> fallback_region=eu-west-1
```
support-ale: Customer says this happens intermittently — their SDK/web client sometimes sends an empty X-Region header (fetch + proxy). They expect the explicit form param to win.
ingrid-eng: We should normalize: treat empty/whitespace-only X-Region as absent. I'll open a small fix to the matcher (edge-router) to treat these as no-op headers and fall back to query/form precedence. Should be a quick change but need canary and QA.
billing-lee: Customer was billed for cross-region egress because of this. I've flagged the account for a provisional credit; need the exact request IDs and timestamp ranges to compute refund. I've asked support-ale for the list.
support-ale: Sent request ids and a short explanation to the customer. They're asking for ETA on a permanent fix.
ingrid-eng: @ops-bot can we push a config change to treat empty header as absent at the edge matcher layer? If not, we'll push a code patch; config is preferred for speed.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026. Starting a canary config rollout to 10% of POPs to normalize header values. Monitoring for 30m then expand. ETA ~2h for full rollout if no regressions.
infra-max: Watching the canary. If stable, we'll roll to prod and also add a log counter so we can notify customers that had blank headers.
support-ale: Great — I'll update the customer with the ETA and the provisional billing credit. Thanks everyone. :pray:
